caption: the week ahead: new moon, venus changes sign, mars stops. jan 4 to jan 10.

slides.headline: this week, *mars* hits the brakes. here's everything else
new moon in *capricorn*: start one serious thing
slides.body: the month's dark moon. astrologers read capricorn as structure. one plan, a real date on it.

slides.headline: *venus* leaves scorpio for sagittarius
slides.body: from secret feelings to said-out-loud feelings. read it as flirting that sounds like a dare.

slides.headline: venus trines neptune, then opposes *uranus*
slides.body: dreamy friday, surprising saturday. good weekend for a date you didn't plan. bad one for deciding forever.

slides.headline: *mars* stations retrograde in *virgo*
slides.body: mars appears to stop, then slide back as earth overtakes it. read it as the redo season. it lasts into spring.

slides.headline: start on thursday. *slow down* on sunday.
slides.body: save this one. tomorrow: the signs whose january changes most.
